draft_text: Mirevant outperforms RookReader in exact-match accuracy on the Norlake-QA test set.
revised_text: Mirevant achieves higher mean exact-match accuracy (74.6%) than RookReader (73.7%) on the Norlake-QA test set, though the paired 95% confidence interval for the difference [-0.12, 1.92] includes zero.
rationale: Mean EM is higher for Mirevant (74.6 vs 73.7), but the paired 95% CI [-0.12, 1.92] includes zero and no p-value was reported, so "outperforms" (implying a reliable difference) is not supported. A narrower claim of higher mean accuracy is defensible.
